episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the critical importance of consistent client communication and how it can prevent lost deals. He explores the role of AI in real estate, emphasizing that while AI can enhance efficiency, it won't replace the emotional intelligence and personal touch that agents provide. The episode provides actionable insights into improving agent productivity and leveraging technology effectively.
